OSSTET Admit Card 2026 - Download Hall Ticket at bseodisha.nic.in - Complete Details

OSSTET Admit Card 2026 is scheduled to be released on 20 September for the Odisha Secondary School Teacher Eligibility Test scheduled on 30 September 2026. Check hall ticket download link, exam date, login details, exam centre information, and important instructions.

Important Dates

  • Exam Name : Odisha Secondary School Teacher Eligibility Test (OSSTET) 2026
  • Admit Card Release Date : 20 September 2026 (as per official schedule)
  • Exam Date : 30 September 2026 (Wednesday)
  • Exam Mode : Offline (pen-and-paper)
  • Admit Card Release Date : 20 September 2026 (scheduled)
  • Examination Date : 30 September 2026

Application Fee

  • Online Application Start : 3 August 2026

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
